operations.title: The fixed exceptional projective direction is not a horizontal rank-one subsystem
operations.description: The exceptional connection sends (0,1,0,-3) to 2t/(t^2-1)(0,1,0,0), a transverse direction. Its minimum horizontal closure is the rank-two plane spanned by e2 and e4.

authority_basis.summary: Continue by testing whether the exceptional projective direction is a horizontal coefficient line.
